For 17 years PhysioFunction have been helping people maximise their independence following life changing events such as stroke, acquired brain or spinal cord injury and other neurological conditions. When other healthcare services have reached the limit of their time and resources we can often pick up the baton and help our clients continue their rehabilitation journey to reach their potential. 

Our team of highly trained specialist Physiotherapists, Sports Therapists, Lifestyle and Nutrition Coaches and Occupational Therapists aim to maximise our client's independence with individually tailored treatment sessions in one of our clinics, in the client's home, in nursing/residential homes or via our TeleRehab service.
